== English errata comparison sources ==
The original English Limited face says “any starship he pilots.” Decipher's November 1998 Glossary Version 2.0 prints the replacement “anything he pilots,” Both complete errata images carry that wording. The normal image has a D-E1 footer and the high-resolution image has an E stamp. Both the English Revised and Reflections foil faces use “anything.” The foil also quotes “hit.” They are separate printings. Virtual editions have their own text history.
